call_points.text: Long-term top-line growth guided at 20%+ CAGR, but no specific FY27 revenue or margin number.
Odisha greenfield project dropped for now; the plant is not dropped altogether, location to be decided later.
MoEF notification on March 31, 2026 reaffirmed mandatory recycled plastic usage targets, improving rPET demand visibility.
Net debt at ₹375 Cr, described as comfortable.
Management declined to give product-wise EBITDA per kg or specific margin guidance, citing volatile prices.
Another 22,500 tons expansion plus debottlenecking planned to push installed capacity to ~1 lakh tons by FY27-end.
MOEFCC issued its notification on 31st March, 2026, keeping mandatory recycled plastics use targets intact.
rFilament yarn has qualified with a leading global textile brand, which the filing says paves the way for higher sales volumes.
rPSF and spun yarn face a demand slowdown from the Middle East conflict, which raised virgin polymer and PET bottle scrap prices.
Value-added products targeted at ~65% of revenue versus 40% currently.
Operating cash flow generated during FY26 was ₹170.70 crore.

operating_notes.text: Preferential issue proceeds of ₹149.97 Cr fully utilized towards machinery capex, debt repayment, and general corporate purposes by March 31, 2026.
Decided to drop the greenfield project at Odisha and expand existing rPET capacity at Warangal by 22,500 TPA for ₹125 Cr by March 2027.
FY26 consolidated operating cash flow was ₹170.70 Cr against capex of ₹176.37 Cr, leaving free cash flow of about -₹5.67 Cr.
Q4FY26 cost of materials consumed was 64.3% of revenue against 60.9% in Q4FY25.
Q4FY26 consolidated production was 45,162 MT and sales 41,268 MT; standalone production 29,234 MT and sales 31,107 MT.
Standalone capacity utilization was 105% and Warangal operations 67% in Q4FY26.
Total installed capacity is 218,940 MTPA across six manufacturing facilities.
Q4FY26 consolidated production 41,268 tonnes, up 6.45% QoQ; sales 45,162 tonnes, up 12.25% QoQ.
Standalone Q4FY26 production 28,209 tonnes and sales 29,234 tonnes, down 3% and 6% QoQ.
rPET capacity 64,500 tonnes, of which 42,000 operational and 22,500 awaiting FSSAI approval; target ~1 lakh tonnes by FY27-end.
FSSAI authorised Ganesha Ecopet's 4th rPET line at Kakatiya Mega Textile Park, Warangal, to make food-grade rPET on Starlinger recoSTAR PET technology, valid 15 Oct 2026 to 14 Oct 2028.

timeline.summary: On May 15, 2026, Ganesha Ecosphere submitted the ICRA monitoring agency report for Q4 FY2026, confirming full utilization of ₹149.97 Cr preferential warrant proceeds.
On May 21, 2026, Ganesha Ecosphere announced it dropped its Odisha greenfield project and instead expanded its Warangal rPET capacity by 22,500 TPA for ₹125 Cr.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹423.94 Cr (+23.1% YoY), net profit ₹23.21 Cr (-2.3% YoY).
Ganesha Ecosphere published its Q4FY26 investor presentation detailing operational and financial results.
Ganesha Ecosphere Limited shared the audio recording link for its Post Results Earnings Conference Call on May 22, 2026, discussing audited standalone & consolidated financial results for Q4FY26.

On May 29, 2026, Ganesha Ecosphere filed the transcript of its Q4FY26 earnings call held on May 22, 2026, where management guided FY27 EBITDA of ₹225-250 Cr and said the 22,500-tonne Warangal rPET line was commissioned and awaiting FSSAI approval.

On 15 October 2026, FSSAI granted Ganesha Ecopet Private Limited, the wholly owned subsidiary, approval for its 4th rPET production line at Kakatiya Mega Textile Park, Warangal, to make food-grade rPET, valid to 14 October 2028.
